citations.A1: Cache never invalidated once set — `_cache is None` only true before first load — fix: cache keyed/checked against file mtime (or hash), reload when it changes.
citations.A2: Reducing a TTL/adding a timer-based refresh — masks the bug, still serves stale data between refreshes
citations.A4: `path` parameter ignored after first call — a second call with a different path still returns the first file's cached data
